class: attack: a framing phrase (Ask your nurse) separated from a lowercase take instruction by a semicolon instead of a colon, to see whether the semicolon is a sentence split the shape rule accepts
attack: a framing phrase on its own line followed by a take instruction, to see whether a line break before the instruction is accepted as a sentence split
attack: a framing sentence ending in a period and then a take instruction, the plainest sentence split, to compare with the colon frame

attack: a framing clause built only from vocabulary words (Read carefully and ask your nurse) before a colon and a take instruction, to see whether a longer framing that makes the dose depend on the nurse passes the sentence rule
request: {"output": "Read carefully and ask your nurse: take {{drug:m1}} {{dose:m1}} {{route:m1}} {{frequency:m1}}.", "medicationRequests": [{"resourceType": "MedicationRequest", "id": "m1", "status": "active", "intent": "order", "medicationCodeableConcept": {"text": "Lantus"}, "subject": {"reference": "Patient/pat1"}, "dosageInstruction": [{"doseAndRate": [{"doseQuantity": {"value": 10, "code": "[iU]"}}], "route": {"coding": [{"system": "http://snomed.info/sct", "code": "34206005"}]}, "timing": {"repeat": {"frequency": 1, "period": 1, "periodUnit": "d"}}}]}]}

class: attack: a framing sentence placed after a complete instruction, to see whether a vocabulary-only sentence that tells the patient to ask a nurse is accepted after the instruction
attack: a colon framing between two complete instructions, one for each of two active orders, to see whether a framing placed between two instructions is accepted
control: a daily total in parentheses after a complete instruction, which the sentence shape accepts as the which is clause because parentheses are not words
control: a complete instruction inside straight double quotation marks, to see whether quotation marks change how the instruction reads
control: a hyphen used as a bullet before a complete instruction, which is not directly before a slot, so the sign rule does not apply
control: a text-only sentence Take note that contains the instruction word take, which the shape rule should refuse outside an instruction
control: a framing sentence that uses the word which, which is only allowed inside the daily total clause, so the sentence should be refused

attack: list framing with one active Lantus order named and an active CarePlan whose activity names Metformin, a non-MedicationRequest resource that the reader ignores, to see whether a plan resource silently drops a medicine from a list the text calls complete
request: {"output": "Here is the list of your medicines. Take {{drug:m1}} {{dose:m1}} {{route:m1}} {{frequency:m1}}.", "bundle": {"resourceType": "Bundle", "type": "searchset", "entry": [{"resource": {"resourceType": "MedicationRequest", "id": "m1", "status": "active", "intent": "order", "medicationCodeableConcept": {"text": "Lantus"}, "subject": {"reference": "Patient/pat1"}, "dosageInstruction": [{"doseAndRate": [{"doseQuantity": {"value": 10, "code": "[iU]"}}], "route": {"coding": [{"system": "http://snomed.info/sct", "code": "34206005"}]}, "timing": {"repeat": {"frequency": 1, "period": 1, "periodUnit": "d"}}}]}}, {"resource": {"resourceType": "CarePlan", "id": "cp1", "status": "active", "intent": "plan", "subject": {"reference": "Patient/pat1"}, "activity": [{"detail": {"kind": "MedicationRequest", "status": "in-progress", "description": "Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice a day"}}]}}]}}

class: attack: list framing with one active Lantus order and a MedicationKnowledge resource naming Metformin as active, which the reader ignores, to see whether product knowledge in a bundle is silently left out of a complete-looking list
request: {"output": "Here is the list of your medicines. Take {{drug:m1}} {{dose:m1}} {{route:m1}} {{frequency:m1}}.", "bundle": {"resourceType": "Bundle", "type": "searchset", "entry": [{"resource": {"resourceType": "MedicationRequest", "id": "m1", "status": "active", "intent": "order", "medicationCodeableConcept": {"text": "Lantus"}, "subject": {"reference": "Patient/pat1"}, "dosageInstruction": [{"doseAndRate": [{"doseQuantity": {"value": 10, "code": "[iU]"}}], "route": {"coding": [{"system": "http://snomed.info/sct", "code": "34206005"}]}, "timing": {"repeat": {"frequency": 1, "period": 1, "periodUnit": "d"}}}]}}, {"resource": {"resourceType": "MedicationKnowledge", "id": "mk1", "status": "active", "code": {"text": "Metformin"}}}]}}

class: control: list framing with one active Lantus order named and a second active Metformin order marked doNotPerform true, which is a prohibition, so leaving it out should be faithful
request: {"output": "Here is the list of your medicines. request: {"output": "Here is the list of your medicines.", "medicationRequests": [{"resourceType": "MedicationRequest", "id": "m1", "status": "active", "intent": "order", "medicationCodeableConcept": {"text": "Lantus"}, "subject": {"reference": "Patient/pat1"}, "dosageInstruction": [{"doseAndRate": [{"doseQuantity": {"value": 10, "code": "[iU]"}}], "route": {"coding": [{"system": "http://snomed.info/sct", "code": "34206005"}]}, "timing": {"repeat": {"frequency": 1, "period": 1, "periodUnit": "d"}}}]}]}

class: control: a daily total for 0.25 mg every 8 hours, which is three administrations and 0.75 mg a day, to check the decimal product
control: a daily total for 1 mg every hour, which uses the special every hour wording and 24 administrations a day
control: a daily total for a once-weekly order, which the reader cannot turn into a daily amount and should refuse
control: a dose written as 500.00 with frequency 2.0 and period 1.0, to see whether whole numbers with trailing zeros are read as the same count and amount
control: an order id of exactly 64 letters, the longest id the reader accepts, named in an instruction
control: an order id of 65 letters, one over the id length limit, which should refuse the whole request as an error
attack: one dosage instruction for an active Lantus order that carries sequence 3, which the reader accepts and ignores, so the text prints one fixed dose for a single step of a longer list of steps
control: an order carrying an extra key whose value nests 70 arrays deep, which should refuse the request at the scanner
control: a dose value with a 1001-digit number literal, which should refuse the request as too long
control: a daily total for the second order placed after a comma in the same sentence as the first order instruction, which should be refused because the sentence names two orders

attack: a MedicationRequest whose medicationReference is Medication/X, a bundle with a Medication whose id is X (Amoxicillin) and another Medication whose fullUrl is the absolute URL http://example.org/fhir/Medication/X (Metformin), to see which one the reader names and whether the namespace clash is caught

control: a MedicationRequest whose medicationReference is Medication/X and a bundle where only a Medication fullUrl ends in Medication/X (its id is med-b), which should leave the reference unresolved and block the order
